title: 销售速度与采购周期缺货风险
context: 补货主管需要找出采购尚未到货时可能售罄的商品。
requirements: 截止2025年底，近30天销售出库速度；供应商历史实际收货周期按合格收货量加权（使用完整2025年收货记录），无记录则14天；预计需要库存=日均出库×历史周期；仅有效商品且预计需求超过当前库存。
commonError: 把下单承诺日当实际收货日，或以0天替代缺失历史。
executionSteps: 按合格件加权实际交期
mysqlSql: WITH s AS (SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,SUM(-quantity_delta) sold FROM stock_movements WHERE movement_type='sale' AND movement_date BETWEEN '2025-12-02' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY warehouse_id,product_id), l AS (SELECT p.warehouse_id,i.product_id,SUM((b.day_index-a.day_index)*(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected))*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(g.quantity_received-g.quantity_rejected),0) lead_days FROM goods_receipts g JOIN purchase_order_items i ON i.po_item_id=g.po_item_id JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.po_id=i.po_id JOIN calendar_days a ON a.day=p.order_date JOIN calendar_days b ON b.day=g.receipt_date WHERE g.receipt_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.warehouse_id,i.product_id), z AS (SELECT i.warehouse_id,i.product_id,i.quantity,COALESCE(s.sold,0) sold,COALESCE(l.lead_days,14) lead_days FROM inventory_snapshots i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN s ON s.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND s.product_id=i.product_id LEFT JOIN l ON l.warehouse_id=i.warehouse_id AND l.product_id=i.product_id WHERE i.snapshot_date='2025-12-31' AND p.active=1) SELECT warehouse_id,product_id,quantity,sold,ROUND(lead_days,2) lead_days,ROUND(sold*lead_days/30.0-quantity,2) expected_shortage FROM z WHERE sold*lead_days/30.0>quantity ORDER BY expected_shortage DESC,warehouse_id,product_id
